title: Event structured data always showed the generic site card as the image, even when the event had its own public cover

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, two independent finders: seo-jsonld and seo-social). lib/jsonld.ts eventSchema published image: [SITE_OG_IMAGE] for every event, and the public event page already spreads enrichment.cover_url (a getPublicUrl string on the public event-media bucket, the same construction the image sitemap uses) into it. CLOSED 2026-10-05: EventSchemaEnrichment declares cover_url and the image leads with it when present, with the site card second so an event with no cover still meets Google's image requirement; lib/jsonld.test.ts pins both arms. Signed URLs are still never published (LIVE-205).

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("lib/jsonld.ts","utf8");if(!/image: event\.cover_url \? \[event\.cover_url, SITE_OG_IMAGE\] : \[SITE_OG_IMAGE\]/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-660: the Event JSON-LD image is the generic site card even when the event has a public cover, so a rich result or an answer engine shows the wrong picture for every event.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
